questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the joint where the arm bends?
explanation: Elbow is the correct spelling - E-L-B-O-W. The elbow is the joint in the middle of the arm.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the joint in the middle of the leg?
explanation: Knee is the correct spelling - K-N-E-E. The knee is the joint between the upper and lower leg. The K is silent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the bony frame of the body?
explanation: Skeleton is the correct spelling - S-K-E-L-E-T-O-N. The skeleton is the framework of bones that supports the body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the tissue that moves bones?
explanation: Muscle is the correct spelling - M-U-S-C-L-E. Muscles contract and relax to move the body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the tube that carries air to the lungs?
explanation: Windpipe is the correct spelling - W-I-N-D-P-I-P-E. The windpipe carries air from the throat to the lungs.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the red liquid in the body?
explanation: Blood is the correct spelling - B-L-O-O-D. Blood carries oxygen and nutrients around the body. It has double O.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the organ that pumps blood?
explanation: Heart is the correct spelling - H-E-A-R-T. The heart is the muscle that pumps blood around the body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the organs used for breathing?
explanation: Lungs is the correct spelling - L-U-N-G-S. Lungs take in oxygen and release carbon dioxide.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the organ that controls the body?
explanation: Brain is the correct spelling - B-R-A-I-N. The brain is the control centre of the entire body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the organ that filters blood?
explanation: Liver is the correct spelling - L-I-V-E-R. The liver filters blood and produces bile for digestion.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the blood vessel that carries blood away from the heart?
explanation: Artery is the correct spelling - A-R-T-E-R-Y. Arteries carry blood from the heart to the rest of the body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the blood vessel that carries blood to the heart?
explanation: Vein is the correct spelling - V-E-I-N. Veins carry blood from the body back to the heart.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the basic unit of the body?
explanation: Cell is the correct spelling - C-E-L-L. Cells are the basic building blocks of all living things. It ends with double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the group of similar cells working together?
explanation: Tissue is the correct spelling - T-I-S-S-U-E. Tissue is a group of similar cells working together. It has double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the organ in the eye that senses light?
explanation: Retina is the correct spelling - R-E-T-I-N-A. The retina is the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the small organs that filter blood waste?
explanation: Kidneys is the correct spelling - K-I-D-N-E-Y-S. The kidneys filter waste from the blood and produce urine.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the transparent front layer of the eye?
explanation: Cornea is the correct spelling - C-O-R-N-E-A. The cornea is the clear protective layer at the front of the eye.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the joint that connects the foot to the leg?
explanation: Ankle is the correct spelling - A-N-K-L-E. The ankle is the joint that connects the foot to the lower leg.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the flat bone at the front of the chest?
explanation: Sternum is the correct spelling - S-T-E-R-N-U-M. The sternum is the flat bone in the centre of the chest.

questionText: Choose the correctly spelled word: 'The _____ connects the upper arm to the shoulder blade.'
explanation: Humerus is the correct spelling - H-U-M-E-R-U-S. The humerus is the long bone in the upper arm.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the thigh bone?
explanation: Femur is the correct spelling - F-E-M-U-R. The femur is the longest bone in the human body, found in the thigh.

questionText: One of these body part words is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Tishue is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is tissue - T-I-S-S-U-E. Artery, retina, and cornea are all correct.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the part of the brain that controls balance?
explanation: Cerebellum is the correct spelling - C-E-R-E-B-E-L-L-U-M. The cerebellum controls balance and coordination. It has double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the largest part of the brain?
explanation: Cerebrum is the correct spelling - C-E-R-E-B-R-U-M. The cerebrum is the largest part of the brain, responsible for thought.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the tube connecting the mouth to the stomach?
explanation: Esophagus is the correct spelling - E-S-O-P-H-A-G-U-S. The esophagus carries food from the mouth to the stomach.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the muscle separating chest from abdomen?
explanation: Diaphragm is the correct spelling - D-I-A-P-H-R-A-G-M. The diaphragm is a dome-shaped muscle that controls breathing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the gland that produces insulin?
explanation: Pancreas is the correct spelling - P-A-N-C-R-E-A-S. The pancreas produces insulin and digestive enzymes.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the gland that controls growth?
explanation: Pituitary is the correct spelling - P-I-T-U-I-T-A-R-Y. The pituitary gland is called the master gland as it controls other glands.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of small vessels connecting arteries and veins?
explanation: Capillaries is the correct spelling - C-A-P-I-L-L-A-R-I-E-S. Capillaries are tiny blood vessels that connect arteries and veins. It has double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the membrane surrounding the lungs?
explanation: Pleura is the correct spelling - P-L-E-U-R-A. The pleura is the double membrane that surrounds the lungs.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of tissue that connects bones at joints?
explanation: Ligament is the correct spelling - L-I-G-A-M-E-N-T. Ligaments are tough bands of tissue that connect bones at joints.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of tissue connecting muscle to bone?
explanation: Tendon is the correct spelling - T-E-N-D-O-N. Tendons are fibrous cords that attach muscles to bones.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the rubbery tissue cushioning joints?
explanation: Cartilage is the correct spelling - C-A-R-T-I-L-A-G-E. Cartilage is the smooth tissue that cushions bones at joints.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the body system that fights disease?
explanation: Immune is the correct spelling - I-M-M-U-N-E. The immune system protects the body from disease and infection. It has double M.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the process of breaking down food?
explanation: Digestion is the correct spelling - D-I-G-E-S-T-I-O-N. Digestion is the process of breaking down food into nutrients.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the hollow space in the abdomen?
explanation: Abdomen is the correct spelling - A-B-D-O-M-E-N. The abdomen is the region of the body containing digestive organs.

questionText: One of these medical words is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Pitutary is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is pituitary - P-I-T-U-I-T-A-R-Y. Cerebellum, diaphragm, and pancreas are all correct.

questionText: One of these words is spelled INCORRECTLY. Which one?
explanation: Capilaries is spelled incorrectly. The correct spelling is capillaries - C-A-P-I-L-L-A-R-I-E-S. It needs double L. Ligament, tendon, and cartilage are all correct.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the collarbone?
explanation: Clavicle is the correct spelling - C-L-A-V-I-C-L-E. The clavicle, also known as the collarbone, connects the shoulder to the chest.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the shinbone in the lower leg?
explanation: Tibia is the correct spelling - T-I-B-I-A. The tibia is the larger of the two bones in the lower leg.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the bony cage protecting the heart?
explanation: Ribcage is the correct spelling - R-I-B-C-A-G-E. The ribcage protects the heart and lungs.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the bone protecting the brain?
explanation: Skull is the correct spelling - S-K-U-L-L. The skull is the bony structure that protects the brain. It ends with double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the process of taking in oxygen?
explanation: Respiration is the correct spelling - R-E-S-P-I-R-A-T-I-O-N. Respiration is the process of breathing and exchanging gases in the body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the system of organs that circulates blood?
explanation: Circulatory is the correct spelling - C-I-R-C-U-L-A-T-O-R-Y. The circulatory system includes the heart, blood, and blood vessels.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the system of bones and joints?
explanation: Skeletal is the correct spelling - S-K-E-L-E-T-A-L. The skeletal system is made up of all the bones in the body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the system controlling body reactions?
explanation: Nervous is the correct spelling - N-E-R-V-O-U-S. The nervous system controls reactions and sends signals through the body.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the coloured part of the eye?
explanation: Iris is the correct spelling - I-R-I-S. The iris is the coloured ring around the pupil of the eye.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the dark opening in the eye that lets in light?
explanation: Pupil is the correct spelling - P-U-P-I-L. The pupil is the dark opening in the centre of the eye that controls light entry.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the joint connecting the hand to the arm?
explanation: Wrist is the correct spelling - W-R-I-S-T. The wrist is the flexible joint connecting the hand to the forearm.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the organ that stores bile?
explanation: Gallbladder is the correct spelling - G-A-L-L-B-L-A-D-D-E-R. The gallbladder stores bile. It has double L and double D.
